description: This file defines a Flutter widget called RecipeCard, which visually represents a recipe with an image, title, description, and metadata such as duration and difficulty. It includes interactive elements like tap and favorite toggle callbacks.

classes.name: RecipeCard
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that displays a recipe thumbnail including image, title, description, duration, difficulty, and favorite toggling.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the widget tree representing the recipe card based on the provided Recipe object and callback functions.

methods.name: _pill
methods.description: Helper widget that creates a pill-shaped container with an icon and text to display metadata such as duration or difficulty.
